checklist.item: Secrets and server texts (tokens, header values, SMTP or upstream replies, file contents) in errors, logs and responses.
checklist.evidence: Running service against a fake api with a contract-valid check that has user info and a query token in url, a headers.authorization value, a request body with the token, and URLs with user info and a query inside lastReason and an incident reason. With PULSE_STATUS_HIDE_DETAILS=false: /api/checks, /api/incidents?status=open, /api/uptime, /, /feed.atom, /badge/web.svg, /metrics, /readyz and /healthz have 0 hits of the token, token=, key=, user:, admin: or Bearer (the 10 pattern hits on / are data-key= attributes). Upstream 500 with a stack text, 401 with an error text, non-JSON, text/html, over 5 MiB and timeout give {"error":"API error"}, {"error":"invalid API response"} or {"error":"API unreachable"}; no log line with the token. Hidden mode: 14 routes, 0 hits of check ids, names, hosts or IPs. PULSE_API_URL with user info: startup log "apiUrl":"http://127.0.0.1:47100"; invalid value: 'PULSE_API_URL is not a valid URL'. Bad PULSE_STATUS_PUBLIC_URL, POLL_MS, PULSE_LOG_LEVEL and PULSE_STATUS_HIDE_DETAILS values are not repeated. Defects: SEC-3 (non-list body served unfiltered), SEC-4 (logo URL credentials in page and error), SEC-5 (theme parse error repeats a file token). With details shown a reason keeps non-URL text, documented in docs/operation.md:92.

checklist.item: Authentication before any other check; status codes and their order on admin routes.
checklist.evidence: status has no admin or authenticated routes; every route is public and read-only by design (docs/operation.md:82). Order seen with curl: any method other than GET and HEAD gets 405 (allow: GET, HEAD) before routing, for /api/checks, /metrics and / (POST, PUT, DELETE, PATCH, OPTIONS, TRACE). A path off the proxy allow-list gets 404 before any upstream request (the fake api saw only /checks and /components during 15 traversal and query variants).

checklist.item: Body and size limits on every method, also before any write.
checklist.evidence: status never reads a request body and never writes. POST, PUT, DELETE, PATCH, OPTIONS with 100 MiB: 405, upload=0; without Expect: 405 after 2,359,296 bytes. GET /healthz with 100 MiB: 200, body drained; RSS 66,024 kB before, 67,560 kB after. 70 KB header and 60 KB target: 431. Unfinished request head closed after 12.0 s. If-None-Match over 8,192 characters is not parsed. Badge label over 32 code points or with a control character: 400. Upstream uncompressed 6 MiB: 502 invalid API response, RSS 75,748 kB to a peak of 76,360 kB. A compressed body of a few KiB gets around the cap (SEC-1, P2).

checklist.item: Input validation at every trust boundary; validators never throw on any input type.
checklist.evidence: Fuzz script, 1,127 calls (47 call variants x 23 values: undefined, null, NaN, BigInt, symbol, function, invalid Date, null-prototype, sparse array, junk arrays, own __proto__ key, out-of-range numbers, getter objects, throwing and revoked proxies). validateChecksResponse, validateLatencyResponse, validateManualIncident, isPublicManualIncident and ifNoneMatchHits: 0 throws. filterApiBody, hideCheckIds, limitResolvedWindow, parseComponentsSnapshot, parseActiveCheckIds: 0 throws on JSON-shaped values. Throws only from proxies (109), non-strings passed to string-typed helpers (54), parseThemeFile by design (15) and componentLatency, whose only caller passes validated values (src/server.ts:545). Over HTTP: an own __proto__ key and 100,000-deep nesting give 200 with the key dropped or []. HTML, </script>, quotes and a {{title}} placeholder in names, reasons, notes and manual incidents are escaped on the page (0 raw <img, 10 escaped), in the feed and in the badge. Defects: SEC-3, SEC-6, SEC-7.

checklist.item: No accessor or getter of untrusted input runs.
checklist.evidence: Every untrusted value reaches status as a string (request line, headers, environment) or as JSON.parse output (api answers through contract fetchJson, the theme file); neither can hold an accessor. The fuzz shows that the filters in src/api-filter.ts and src/hidden-checks.ts would run own getters (167 getter calls in 22 call variants); the contract validators ran none. That path cannot be reached today (note N6).

checklist.item: SSRF: allowed targets, environment lookups, redirects (cross-origin, https to http), forwarded headers.
checklist.evidence: Allowed targets: PULSE_API_URL plus one of 10 fixed paths; the raw target must equal the parsed path and query (src/server.ts:648). .., %2e%2e, //, trailing /, extra or empty query, %3F, %00 and case variants give 404 with no upstream request; absolute-form and //host targets give 404. 31 static paths tried: 404 for every traversal or alias, 200 only for allow-listed files. Forwarded headers: none; a request with Host, X-Forwarded-For, X-Forwarded-Host, Cookie and Authorization reached the api with only accept, accept-encoding, connection, host (the api's own) and user-agent. User info in PULSE_API_URL is never sent (authorization null on both hops). Redirects: proxy, page render and readiness poll follow 302 and 307 to another origin and 302 from https to http (SEC-2). Redirect to a file: URL: 502 API unreachable. Environment: src reads process.env only in src/main.ts:10 and :22; Bun fetch uses HTTP_PROXY (note N1).

status writes no files: grep -rnE "writeFile|appendFile|createWriteStream|mkdir|rename|unlink|rmSync|Bun\.write|fs\.write|openSync" src public scripts (tests excluded) has no hits. The image runs as uid=1000(bun) and /app is owned by root (touch /app/x: Permission denied). Reads are path-safe: fixed allow-lists (src/server.ts:128, :177, :189, :217, :261); zod files are resolved inside the package and accepted only in their canonical spelling (src/server.ts:223 to :240).

checklist.item: Dependencies, Docker base images and CI actions pinned and approved (`docs/approved-packages.md`).
checklist.evidence: package.json: runtime fonts 5.3.0, zod 4.6.7, contract and kit by full SHA; dev @axe-core/playwright 4.14.0, @biomejs/biome 2.6.3, @types/bun 1.4.0, @types/node 26.6.6, lefthook 2.2.2, playwright 1.64.1, typescript7 npm:typescript@7.0.2, pulse-config by SHA: all exact and approved. All 164 bun.lock package entries carry a sha512 hash. Production install: 5 packages (two fonts, contract 2.1.0, kit 0.1.0, zod 4.6.7). Dockerfile: both stages oven/bun:1.4.0-alpine@sha256:07235578f79ef8c6f97d94aee7938e76f5cdba5f21ae5dbfdd3d3d38058437eb (approved); unpinned apk add git in the build stage only (note N4). docker build exit 0; image runs ["bun","--no-env-file","src/main.ts"] as bun, no test files, no e2e, no playwright, no git. CI: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 (v7.0.1) with persist-credentials: false, oven-sh/setup-bun@0c5077e51419868618aeaa5fe8019c62421857d6 (v2.2.0), pulse-config workflows by SHA, top-level permissions contents: read; bun run lint: 'pulse-workflows: ok (1 files, 5 uses)', exit 0. bun audit: 1 moderate, minimatch@10.2.6, dev only (note N3).

findings.title: A compressed upstream answer gets around the 5 MiB body cap, and status uses memory up to its decoded size
findings.command: The fake api answers GET /checks with a brotli body of a few KiB that decodes to 1 GiB. One anonymous GET /api/checks on the running service, then 12 s with no client request (readiness poll only); RSS of the status process sampled every 0.1 s with ps.
findings.excerpt: status=502 bytes=32 time=2.84 {"error":"invalid API response"}; rss before 66,468 kB, peak 1,321,780 kB, after 1,087,292 kB. Poll only: rss before 75,940 kB, peak 1,339,204 kB, upstream requests: /checks,/checks. Uncompressed 6 MiB for comparison: 502, rss 75,748 kB to 76,360 kB.
findings.impact: One answer from whatever the api URL reaches (the api, a proxy in front of it, a redirect target, or an on-path attacker on a plain-http PULSE_API_URL) makes the public status service allocate more than 1 GiB. The readiness poll repeats it every POLL_MS without any visitor, and visitors trigger new reads every PULSE_STATUS_CACHE_MS. A memory-limited container is killed and the status page goes down. The documented 5 MiB cap (README.md:63, docs/operation.md:153) does not bound memory.
findings.fixDirection: In the fetch that status passes to fetchJson (the proxy's recordingFetch at src/server.ts:389 and the readiness poll's doFetch at src/api-poll.ts:24), set Bun's decompress: false and refuse a Content-Encoding other than identity, or move to a contract version that does this in fetchJson (contract main src/client.ts:131 does not yet). Add a test with an encoded answer.

findings.title: The proxy serves a non-list upstream body unfiltered, also with details hidden
findings.command: The fake api answers 200 application/json on each list route with a JSON object that holds a check URL with user info and a query token and a headers.authorization value; GET the matching /api/* route on the running service, once with details shown and once with all settings at their defaults.
findings.excerpt: /api/checks, /api/uptime, /api/latency, /api/maintenance, /api/incidents?status=open -> 200 with an etag, secret-in-body=1 (the upstream object byte for byte); /api/components -> 502 {"error":"invalid API response"}. Defaults: same 200 body. A list body: [{"id":"web","name":"Web","type":"http","state":"down","lastReason":null,"locations":[]}].

findings.title: The proxy, the page render and the readiness poll follow redirects to other origins and from https to http
findings.command: The fake api answers GET /checks with a 302 to another port and GET /uptime with a 307 to another path on that port; an https api with a throwaway certificate answers every path with a 302 to plain http. GET /api/checks and /api/uptime on the running service; request log of the other origin.
findings.excerpt: cross-origin 302: 200 [{"id":"EVIL-ORIGIN-DATA","name":"evil","type":"http","state":"up"}]; 307 to another path: 200 [{}], other origin logged /internal-only; https to http: 200 with the plain-http data, requests at the plain-http host: 3 (/checks,/checks,/components); file: URL: 502 API unreachable; authorization null at the other origin.

findings.title: Credentials in a PULSE_STATUS_LOGO URL are published in the page and repeated in the startup error
findings.command: env -i PATH=$PATH HOME=$HOME PULSE_API_URL=http://127.0.0.1:47100 PULSE_STATUS_LOGO='https://logouser:<password>@cdn.example/logo.svg' bun --no-env-file src/main.ts, then curl -s -i http://127.0.0.1:47182/; and a start with an https logo value with user info that cannot be parsed.
findings.excerpt: ; CSP img-src 'self' data: https://cdn.example. Second start: pulse-status: PULSE_STATUS_LOGO: invalid URL https://u:@[bad (exit 2). stands for the test value, which appeared in full.

findings.title: A theme file that is not valid JSON makes the startup error repeat a token of the file
findings.command: env -i PATH=$PATH HOME=$HOME PULSE_STATUS_THEME=<file with a bare word where a value should be> bun --no-env-file src/main.ts
findings.excerpt: pulse-status: theme file <dir>/badtheme3.json: invalid JSON: JSON Parse error: Unexpected identifier "ghp_AbCdEf0123456789SecretTokenValue" (a 36-character test token in full). A plain-text file: Unexpected identifier "TOKEN". A bad JSON value: light.bg: invalid value (no value).

findings.title: /feed.atom answers 500 for a manual incident update time outside the Date range
findings.command: The fake api returns one manual incident whose update has a finite at far outside the Date range; GET /feed.atom, /, /api/manual-incidents on the running service with PULSE_STATUS_PUBLIC_URL set; service log.
findings.excerpt: /feed.atom 500 {"error":"internal error"}; / 200; /api/manual-incidents 200; log: "msg":"request failed","path":"/feed.atom","error":"Invalid Date", stack at rfc3339 (src/feed.ts:68:23) at buildAtom (src/feed.ts:166:63).

findings.title: A request target that the URL parser rejects gets no HTTP answer and no log line
findings.command: A raw request whose absolute-form target the WHATWG URL parser rejects, sent to the running service and to a bare node:http server under Bun 1.4.0; /metrics before and after; service log.
findings.excerpt: status: (connection closed without answer), no log line, /healthz ok, pulse_status_http_requests_total unchanged apart from the /metrics read (code="200" 47 -> 48). Bare server: HTTP/1.1 200 OK ... url=<the target>. new URL throws: TypeError Invalid URL.
